summary: Iteration 55 — Validated the full P0 batch (Cases 1-4). 21/21 backend pytest tests PASSED and the frontend LeadDetail (/leads/500178), Follow-ups (/followups), and Admin (/admin?tab=Dropdowns) UI pieces are wired correctly.

issues: Empty state ('Nothing here') does not render the 'Follow Date/Follow Time/Status' column headers, so testers can't visually confirm the columns until at least one follow-up exists in the bucket. Cards row (Total/Completed/Rescheduled/Cancelled/Pending) is correct and 'Not Done' card is absent as required.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/leads.py followups_reminders() (Case 2) applies the [sched-5, sched] window on minute-of-day (now_min) but does NOT filter by follow_up_date, so a follow-up scheduled for a *different* date whose HH:MM happens to fall in the current window would still fire. It's currently gated by the `follow_up_date: day` match — good — but the docstring/logic could be misread. Consider a comment or an assert to make that invariant explicit.

routes/whatsapp.py list_channels caller filter uses only owner_id; if a channel's owner_id is None (legacy WA channels not yet backfilled), a caller will silently never see it even if they've since been assigned the matching lead. Confirmed via test: preview channels for the 120k synthetic leads have owner_id=None and are invisible to callers until an assignment triggers sync_channel_owner. Product-acceptable per spec, but consider a periodic backfill job or a lookup fallback (channel.phone_digits → lead.user_id) on read for safety.
routes/reports.py dashboard() base is now {active:True, pipeline:{$ne:False}} which now matches ?bucket=pipeline — verified numerically equal (119808 == 119808). Good.

routes/catalogs.py PUT /disposition-map auto-creates missing 'tag' catalog items — verified end-to-end. Consider case-insensitive dedupe (e.g. 'Ringing' vs 'ringing') before upsert to avoid duplicate tag rows from admin typos.
